title: Add NetworkManager version somewhere
line: Info Center's Network Interfaces page now shows the NetworkManager version at the top.
explanation: Neither Info Center nor the network settings showed which NetworkManager version the system runs, so people filing network bugs had to run nmcli -v in a terminal. The reporter looked for it in Info Center's Network page, which only showed the output of ip address. The page now reads NetworkManager's Version property over the system D-Bus (1 s timeout) and prints "NetworkManager <version>" above the interface list; when NetworkManager isn't running the page looks as before.

commits.message:
kcms/network: show the NetworkManager version above the interfaces

Finding which NetworkManager version a system runs, for example when
filing a bug, needed a terminal. The page now asks NetworkManager for its
version over D-Bus and prints it before the interface list when it runs.

BUG: 465656

patches.diff:
From cba8abb946f4b383ea20fc76d168368500af15ec Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 22:37:55 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] kcms/network: show the NetworkManager version above the
 interfaces

Finding which NetworkManager version a system runs, for example when
filing a bug, needed a terminal. The page now asks NetworkManager for its
version over D-Bus and prints it before the interface list when it runs.

BUG: 465656
---
 kcms/network/CMakeLists.txt |  2 +-
 kcms/network/ip.sh          |  9 +++++++--
 kcms/network/main.cpp       | 20 +++++++++++++++++++-
 3 files changed, 27 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)

diff --git a/kcms/network/CMakeLists.txt b/kcms/network/CMakeLists.txt
index d0442d93..968e39ba 100644
--- a/kcms/network/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/kcms/network/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -10,6 +10,6 @@ set_package_properties(aha PROPERTIES TYPE RUNTIME)
 add_definitions(-DTRANSLATION_DOMAIN=\"kcm_network\")
 
 kinfocenter_add_kcm(kcm_network main.cpp)
-target_link_libraries(kcm_network PRIVATE Qt::Gui KF6::CoreAddons KF6::KCMUtilsQuick KF6::I18n KInfoCenterInternal)
+target_link_libraries(kcm_network PRIVATE Qt::Gui Qt::DBus KF6::CoreAddons KF6::KCMUtilsQuick KF6::I18n KInfoCenterInternal)
 
 install(FILES ip.sh DESTINATION ${KDE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/kinfocenter/network)
diff --git a/kcms/network/ip.sh b/kcms/network/ip.sh
index 6bd985bc..228044b3 100755
--- a/kcms/network/ip.sh
+++ b/kcms/network/ip.sh
@@ -5,6 +5,7 @@
 set -e
 
 DARKNESS="$1"
+NM_VERSION="$2"
 
 AHA_ARGS=""
 if [ "$DARKNESS" -eq "1" ]; then
@@ -17,6 +18,10 @@ fi
 # (so before entries in index range 2-9, or anything double-or-more digit).
 
 # For sed testing please use --posix on GNU sed so you don't end up using gnu-isms.
-ip -color -statistics -human-readable address 2>&1 \
-    | sed -E 's@^([2-9]|[0-9]{2,}):@\n\1:@g' \
+{
+    if [ -n "$NM_VERSION" ]; then
+        printf 'NetworkManager %s\n\n' "$NM_VERSION"
+    fi
+    ip -color -statistics -human-readable address 2>&1
+} | sed -E 's@^([2-9]|[0-9]{2,}):@\n\1:@g' \
     | aha $AHA_ARGS
diff --git a/kcms/network/main.cpp b/kcms/network/main.cpp
index a49284d3..e809eddf 100644
--- a/kcms/network/main.cpp
+++ b/kcms/network/main.cpp
@@ -3,6 +3,9 @@
     SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2024 Harald Sitter <sitter@kde.org>
 */
 
+#include <QDBusConnection>
+#include <QDBusMessage>
+#include <QDBusVariant>
 #include <QGuiApplication>
 #include <QStandardPaths>
 #include <QStyleHints>
@@ -24,7 +27,8 @@ public:
     {
         const QString executable = QStandardPaths::locate(QStandardPaths::GenericDataLocation, u"kinfocenter/network/ip.sh"_s, QStandardPaths::LocateFile);
         const QString darkness = QGuiApplication::styleHints()->colorScheme() == Qt::ColorScheme::Dark ? u"1"_s : u"0"_s;
-        m_outputContext = new CommandOutputContext({u"ip"_s, u"aha"_s}, u"/bin/sh"_s, {executable, darkness}, Qt::TextFormat::RichText, parent);
+        m_outputContext =
+            new CommandOutputContext({u"ip"_s, u"aha"_s}, u"/bin/sh"_s, {executable, darkness, networkManagerVersion()}, Qt::TextFormat::RichText, parent);
     }
     CommandOutputContext *outputContext() const
     {
@@ -32,6 +36,20 @@ public:
     }
 
 private:
+    static QString networkManagerVersion()
+    {
+        auto message = QDBusMessage::createMethodCall(u"org.freedesktop.NetworkManager"_s,
+                                                      u"/org/freedesktop/NetworkManager"_s,
+                                                      u"org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties"_s,
+                                                      u"Get"_s);
+        message << u"org.freedesktop.NetworkManager"_s << u"Version"_s;
+        const QDBusMessage reply = QDBusConnection::systemBus().call(message, QDBus::Block, 1000);
+        if (reply.type() != QDBusMessage::ReplyMessage || reply.arguments().isEmpty()) {
+            return {};
+        }
+        return reply.arguments().constFirst().value<QDBusVariant>().variant().toString();
+    }
+
     CommandOutputContext *m_outputContext;
 };
 
--
